name: WhiteNoise
description: White noise generator. Generates random values at full sample rate with equal distribution across all frequencies.

name: PinkNoise
description: Pink noise generator. Generates noise with equal energy per octave (1/f spectrum).

name: BrownNoise
description: Brown noise generator. Generates noise with a 1/f² spectrum, also called red or Brownian noise.

name: GrayNoise
description: Gray noise generator. Generates noise that sounds equally loud at all frequencies to the human ear.

name: Dust
description: Random impulse generator. Generates random impulses from 0 to +1 at a rate determined by the density argument.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Average number of impulses per second

name: LFNoise0
description: Step noise generator. Generates random levels at a rate given by freq. Holds each value for 1/freq seconds.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: LFNoise1
description: Linear interpolated noise generator. Generates random levels that are linearly interpolated.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: LFNoise2
description: Quadratic noise generator. Generates random levels with quadratic interpolation between them.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: Dust2
description: Bipolar random impulse generator. Generates random impulses from -1 to +1.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Average number of impulses per second

name: ClipNoise
description: Clip noise generator. Generates noise with only two values: -1 and +1.

name: Crackle
description: Chaotic noise generator. A noise generator based on a chaotic function with parameter control.

inputs.name: chaosParam
inputs.description: Chaos parameter from 1.0 to 2.0. Values from 1.5 to 1.9 produce interesting sounds

name: LFClipNoise
description: Dynamic clip noise generator. Generates noise that switches between -1 and +1 at a given frequency.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: LFDNoise0
description: Dynamic step noise generator. Like LFNoise0 but can have frequency modulation.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: LFDNoise1
description: Dynamic linear interpolated noise. Like LFNoise1 but with frequency modulation support.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: LFDNoise3
description: Dynamic cubic interpolated noise. Generates random levels with cubic interpolation and frequency modulation support.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values

name: Hasher
description: Hash function random generator. Returns a number from 0 to 1 based on a hash of the input value.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal to hash

name: ExpRand
description: Exponential single random number generator. Generates one exponentially distributed random float between lo and hi when the SynthDef starts; the value remains fixed for the synth's lifetime.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Lower limit of the output range (must be positive)

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Upper limit of the output range (must be positive)

name: NRand
description: Sum-of-uniforms random generator. Generates one random float that is the sum of n uniform distributions between lo and hi (n=1 uniform, n=2 triangular, n=3 smooth hump; converges towards Gaussian as n grows). Evaluated once at SynthDef start.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Lower limit of the output range

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Upper limit of the output range

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Number of uniform distributions to sum

name: Logistic
description: Chaotic noise generator based on the logistic map y = chaosParam * y * (1 - y). Useful values for chaosParam are 0.0 to 4.0; chaos onsets above 3.57. Output stays in 0..1, so use mul/add or LeakDC to remove the DC offset.

inputs.name: chaosParam
inputs.description: Chaos parameter (0.0 to 4.0). Chaos occurs above ~3.57; values outside this range may blow up

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Iteration frequency in Hz, clamped to the sample rate

inputs.name: init
inputs.description: Initial value of y in the logistic equation

name: MantissaMask
description: Floating-point precision reducer. Masks off bits in the mantissa of the input sample, introducing softer quantisation noise than linear bit-crushing. Useful as a chiptune-style degrader.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal to degrade

inputs.name: bits
inputs.description: Number of mantissa bits to preserve (0 to 23)

name: RandID
description: Selects which random number generator the synth uses. Synths sharing the same generator id reproduce the same sequence when the same seed is set. Has no audible output.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Random number generator ID

name: RandSeed
description: Resets the synth's random number generator seed when the trigger goes from non-positive to positive. All synths sharing the same RNG id will reproduce the same sequence after a reset. Has no audible output.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal — reseeds on non-positive to positive transition

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Random seed value

name: LFDClipNoise
description: Dynamic clipped noise generator. Like LFClipNoise it outputs -1 or +1 at the given frequency, but without time quantisation and with fast recovery from low freq values, completing the LFDNoise0/1/3 family.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Approximate rate at which to generate random values
